anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: the children shared in blood and flesh… abolish the one who has the power of death, the devil… set free those subject to slavery through fear of death.

pass_a_gloss: Since then the children have shared of blood and flesh, he too likewise partook of the same things, so that through the death he might abolish the one having the might of the death, that is the devil, and set these free, as many as by fear of death through all the living were liable of slavery.
pass_b_english: Since then the children have shared in blood and flesh, he too likewise partook of the same, so that through death he might abolish the one who has the power of death — that is, the devil — and might set free these, as many as through fear of death were subject to slavery through all their living (Hebrews 2:14–15).
source_text: Ἐπεὶ οὖν τὰ παιδία κεκοινώνηκεν αἵματος καὶ σαρκός, καὶ αὐτὸς παραπλησίως μετέσχεν τῶν αὐτῶν, ἵνα διὰ τοῦ θανάτου καταργήσῃ τὸν τὸ κράτος ἔχοντα τοῦ θανάτου, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὸν διάβολον, καὶ ἀπαλλάξῃ τούτους, ὅσοι φόβῳ θανάτου διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν ἔνοχοι ἦσαν δουλείας".
